info.description: Shopping demo API with PHP session authentication. Start with Authentication Ã¢â€ â€™ Log in, then use Try it out on protected endpoints in the same browser. Registration creates demo cards and addresses. Emails are captured locally in MailHog; no real payment is processed. Most legacy validation failures use HTTP 200 with success:false; always inspect the response body.

patch.description: Only the owner can update an active order, and only while its status is Processing. Saved address IDs come from addresses_set_b on the order response. Cancelled and dispatched orders cannot be changed. The change is saved to the order before sending a confirmation email with previous/new addresses and tracking. Re-saving the same address returns changed:false and does not send another notification. Email failure does not undo the saved change.

200.description: JSON response. Check success; validation and business errors may also use HTTP 200.

changed.description: False when the order already uses this saved address.

email_sent.description: Whether the confirmation email was accepted by the local SMTP inbox.
